usage: xo test [--seed=N] [--explore=N] [--run=text] [--race] [--real] [--cases=N]
               [--timeout=D] [--json] [-v] [--backend=go|llvm|arm64|amd64] [--no-gc]
               [--profile=cpu|heap|cpu,heap] [--trace=FILE] [--watch] <dirs...>

Run test blocks, property tests, and contract fuzzing on the
deterministic scheduler. --run selects the tests whose name contains
text; --cases sets the cases per property test and fuzzed function
(default 100); --explore=N runs each test under N schedules; --real
gives tests real capabilities for their declared effects; --timeout
is the real time each test (each property case) may take, 60s by
default, 0 for no limit: a test past it fails and, natively, its
process is killed. Shrunk contract failures are written to the
module's regressions_test.xo. --profile=cpu (heap, cpu,heap) samples
each test process (not property cases) into xo-cpu-<pid>.pprof
(xo-heap-<pid>.pprof) and .txt in the working directory; go tool pprof
merges several. --trace=FILE writes an execution trace per test process
(FILE.<pid>, or FILE with %p); read one with xo trace. --watch runs
the tests, then after each change to the sources only the tests it
reaches (a new or edited test, the tests of a changed _test.xo file,
and the tests that name a function whose definition, or one it uses,
changed); typing a and Enter runs them all. With --json each cycle is
a JSON line, the last also in last.json under <user cache>/xo/watch
(decision 0267).

A directory means that directory alone; DIR/... covers the directories
below it too, up to 6,000 .xo files or 60,000 entries (decision 0345).
A DIR/... with no .xo file at or below DIR is an error.
